recommendations.claim: BPC-157 is the top-indexed soft-tissue healing peptide candidate for MSK recovery support, pending clinician clearance and renal/hepatic baseline.
recommendations.source: vault/compounds/bpc-157.md - evidence_tier C; 4 published human studies, cumulative n~60, no RCT; McGuire 2025 (Curr Rev Musculoskelet Med) explicit 'should not be recommended for clinical use'; Vasireddi 2025 HSS systematic review (544 articles, 1 qualifying human study, n<30)
recommendations.reversibility: SC administration; compound clears in hours (rat IV t-half ~ 15.2 min, no human PK data); practitioner cycle 4-8 weeks with >=4 weeks washout - cycle reversibility is convention, not RCT-validated
